author: Shireen Ahmed
description: Canada's senior women's rugby team will be playing a pair of matches against England in Toronto (Friday, Oct. 16) and Ottawa (Friday, Oct. 23). The Red Roses are ranked No. 1 in the world and beat Canada in the 2025 Women’s Rugby World Cup final last year. The Toronto match is expected to break the standalone record for a North American rugby match.
title: Canadian women's rugby aims to deal England its 1st loss in 41 matches during upcoming double-header

title: Director Alex Gibney on terrifying Musk documentary: 'It's not a funeral; it's a warning'

description: Dozens of fans flooded social media with complaints that Ticketmaster failed to label Backstreet Boys presale tickets appropriately, leaving some fans with seats with obstructed views. Live Nation now says fans whose seats are impacted "will be proactively relocated to comparable full-view locations."
title: Live Nation to relocate Backstreet Boys fans who say they got 'screwed' on seats with obstructed views

author: Chris Regier
description: As an engineer from Saskatchewan, Chris Regier was taken aback by some of the opulence he saw in Alberta's oil and gas sector. He says his decade of experience in the province showed him two things can be true at the same time: Alberta is better off than other provinces and yet there are legitimate concerns about equalization.
title: Living in Calgary showed me Albertans don't realize how good they have it, but their grievances are real

author: Kevin Maimann
description: For more than 50 years, humanity has used "leap seconds" to keep our clocks aligned with the rotation of the Earth. On Thursday, an international time-keeping body in France is expected to do away with leap seconds and let the clocks slip until they're out of alignment by a full hour — meaning it could be centuries, or even millennia, before another tweak is needed.
title: The 'leap second' could disappear. How a minor time adjustment became a major problem
